summary: Read a string sequence and a word. Both contain only lowercase English letters, and each has length from 1 to 100. A repeat count k is allowed when word copied back to back exactly k times shows up as one contiguous stretch inside sequence. Write the largest k that word can achieve inside sequence. If word never shows up as a contiguous stretch, that largest k is 0, and write 0.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
